controls.label: How it moves
controls.hint: H3 takes a rich prompt — you can describe a timeline, and it generates sound too.

inputs.label: The poster
inputs.note: The artwork as supplied. It is used as both the first and the last frame, so the clip loops and the typography cannot drift.

params.prompt:
Warm evening light, shallow depth of field, unhurried.

Timeline:
[0s-2s] The sign fills the frame, light catching its edge.
[2s-5s] Slow drift back, the street coming into view behind it.

No cuts, no camera shake, no text overlays.

Audio: Low room tone, distant traffic, no music.

presets.label: Light sweep
presets.hint: A single highlight travels across the artwork. The safest one — nothing moves but the light.

values.value:
The image is a finished promotional poster. Every designed element — the headline, all body text, prices, dates, times, logos and brand marks — stays exactly where it is, at exactly the same size, perfectly sharp and completely unchanged for the whole clip. No letter re-forms, no word changes, nothing slides or drifts. The camera is locked off. The final frame matches the first frame exactly.

A single soft specular highlight travels slowly across the poster from left to right, once, catching the glossy and metallic parts of the artwork as it passes and leaving them as they were. The light is the only thing that moves.

Do not add or alter any text. No new logos, captions, watermarks or subtitles.

presets.label: Bokeh drift
presets.hint: Soft out-of-focus lights drift behind the artwork. Good for a dark or photographic poster.

presets.label: Slow push
presets.hint: A very slight zoom in and back out. Adds life to a flat poster without moving anything.
